_comment: Checked-in Soroban fee parameters used to price a simulation and to estimate
the refundable component of a resource fee. Values are the Stellar pubnet
captured 2024-12-11. `soroscope` does not read these off the ledger: a quote
must be reproducible and reviewable, and the numbers only ever feed an
ESTIMATE. Never use a quote to set a transaction fee -- use `simulateTransaction`
on the target RPC for that.
Renew when: the RPC's `feeConfig`/`stateArchivalSettings` endpoints are bumped,
or protocol 23 changes the rent model. Bump `captured_at` when you do.
